A_MOVE_ITEM.raw_text: move a file or folder to another location

A_FIND_FILES.raw_text: search for files by name within the sandbox

A_READ_FILE.raw_text: show the contents of a text file

A_OPEN_ITEM.raw_text: open a file or folder with its default program

A_DISK_USAGE.raw_text: show free/used space on available drives

A_KILL_PROCESS.raw_text: stop/close a running process by name

A_GET_TIME.raw_text: what time is it right now

A_CHAT.raw_text: anything else — just answer conversationally, no action needed

A_PATH_EXISTS.raw_text: check whether a file or folder exists

A_ITEM_PROPERTIES.raw_text: show detailed properties of a file or folder

A_RESOLVE_PATH.raw_text: resolve a wildcard or relative path to its full path

A_SPLIT_PATH.raw_text: break a path into its components

A_COUNT_FILES.raw_text: count how many files are in a folder

A_COUNT_FOLDERS.raw_text: count how many subfolders are in a folder

A_FILE_TYPE_BREAKDOWN.raw_text: show a breakdown of file types/extensions in a folder

A_FIND_DUPLICATE_FILES.raw_text: find duplicate files in a folder by comparing size and hash

A_FIND_FILES_BY_CONTENT.raw_text: search inside files under a folder for a text pattern

A_GET_CLIPBOARD.raw_text: show the current text on the clipboard

A_WAIT_FOR_PROCESS.raw_text: wait until a named process stops running

A_FIND_PROCESS.raw_text: show info about one specific running process by name

A_TOP_PROCESSES_BY_CPU.raw_text: show the top N processes sorted by CPU usage

A_OPEN_TASK_MANAGER.raw_text: open the Windows Task Manager window

A_SYSTEM_UPTIME.raw_text: show how long the system has been running since last boot

A_FIND_SERVICE.raw_text: show the status of a named Windows service

A_TOGGLE_MUTE.raw_text: mute or unmute the system volume

A_VOLUME_UP.raw_text: increase the system volume by one step

A_VOLUME_DOWN.raw_text: decrease the system volume by one step

A_TAKE_SCREENSHOT.raw_text: capture the screen and save it as an image file to the Desktop
